cases.english: Right. Which totally shatters the current economic model of how these systems are actually supposed to generate revenue.

cases.english: The very constraints that were supposed to cripple China's tech sector being cut off from advanced chips, the rigid international trade restrictions seem to have forced them to build a highly sustainable, hyper-efficient business model from the ground up.
